page.title: Permissions
page.infoEmptyDescription: No functions of the schorn.ai box are available.
page.infoEmptyAdminDescription: As an admin you can create the first workspace.
page.infoUser: Can view organization content (chatbots, transcribers, documents, repositories, etc.), but cannot edit it.
page.infoEditor: Can view organization content and additionally edit it (create new chatbots, edit documents, delete, etc.).
page.infoAdmin: Can read and write across all organizations and additionally manage system settings (upload XRAG, change colors, etc.) and manage users.
